title: Lion cub with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb84d'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='38' fill='#d9722a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='33' fill='#f29b3f'/>

  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='10' fill='#f29b3f'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='24' r='10' fill='#f29b3f'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='24' r='6' fill='#ffd08a'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='24' r='6' fill='#ffd08a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='27' fill='#ffcf7a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#ffe9b8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M44 64 Q50 60 56 64 Q52 70 50 70 Q48 70 44 64 Z' fill='#c9603a'/>

  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='6.5' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='50' r='3.2' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='50' r='3.2' fill='#8fd3ff'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='47.5' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='47.5' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.8' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <path d='M40.5 52.5 L41.5 54.5 L43.5 55.5 L41.5 56.5 L40.5 58.5 L39.5 56.5 L37.5 55.5 L39.5 54.5 Z' fill='#eaf7ff'/>
  <path d='M64.5 52.5 L65.5 54.5 L67.5 55.5 L65.5 56.5 L64.5 58.5 L63.5 56.5 L61.5 55.5 L63.5 54.5 Z' fill='#eaf7ff'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ffab8a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='62' r='4' fill='#ffab8a' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
